| **Cough producing blood, thick green/yellow sputum, or foul odor** | Suggests bacterial pneumonia needing antibiotics. |
| **Severe, sudden headache with neck stiffness, confusion, or visual changes** | Could indicate meningitis or other neurologic emergency. |
| **Heart rate < 45 bpm with dizziness or fainting** | Bradycardia becoming symptomatic. |
| **Persistent vomiting or inability to keep fluids down** | Risk of dehydration and electrolyte loss. |
